topic: Aircraft servicing form MOD form 700C and explanation of parts, various sections & use of TA-700, Monitoring of differed defects.
syllabus_extract: Aircraft servicing form MOD form 700C and explanation of parts, various sections & use of TA-700, Monitoring of differed defects.
specific_objectives: 1.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain the documentation and various other forms used in naval aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of sample MOD Form 700C and TA-700 entries; Instructor supervision on form identification and defect monitoring logic.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of MOD Form 700C?
Name one other form used for naval aircraft documentation.
Why is monitoring differed defects important for flight safety?

topics: Explanation of form parts and sections
Role of TA-700 in defect tracking
development.content:
Introduction to MOD Form 700C structure
Explanation of form parts and sections

Overview of TA-700 utility
Role of TA-700 in defect tracking

Detailed analysis of TA-700 sections
Process for logging differed defects
Interpretation of defect monitoring data
Link between TA-700 and 700C entries
Standard procedures for defect resolution

topics: Use of TA-700 for maintenance tracking
development.content:

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between MOD Form 700C and TA-700.
Describe the procedure for monitoring differed defects using TA-700.
Identify three critical sections of MOD Form 700C and their uses.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the procedures for filling up concerned parts of MOD Form 700C to be discussed in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: Procedures for filling up concerned parts of MOD form 700C. scheduled maintenance. use of job cards, ground run/ test flight, placing aircraft in limitation/ deferment, defect rectification, independent checks, latitude for routine servicing.
